preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 10 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 10**6 for n in [int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(T)])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of elements n is between 1 and 10^6 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= int(x) <= 10**9 for x in input().split()) for _ in range(T))
preconditions.description: For each test case, all elements a[i] in the sequence are between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout.strip().split()[i] in ['YES', 'NO'] for i in range(T))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is either 'YES' or 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: all((stdout.strip().split()[i] == 'YES') == all(abs(a[j] - (j + 1)) <= 1 for j in range(n)) for i, n in enumerate([int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(T)]))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is 'YES' if and only if all numbers are at most 1 position away from their correct position in a sorted order, otherwise 'NO'.
